finding: The instruction to keep peoples as subject is attached to both the ferment and abrasion metaphors, but it applies only to the ferment clause. In the abrasion sentence, the grammatical subject is whatever foreign material may previously have been introduced; that material experiences the wearing-down influence of restricted native interaction. Applying the current bearer instruction to both clauses would change who or what undergoes the second process.
